FX-ASPEC-001.says: The settings as they start, no Audio Layer: silence, so 64 dots of Side A and Side B together, 3 thick, along the line through the middle, alone.

FX-ASPEC-002.says: Four bands at 300, 600, 900 and 1200 Hz, 8 tall at most, Side A, 2 thick, sharp, alone: the 300 Hz bar half as tall as it can be (4), the 1200 Hz bar a quarter (2), the two between all but nothing.

FX-ASPEC-003.says: FX-ASPEC-002 with Composite On Original on: over the cel.

FX-ASPEC-004.says: Side B: the bars hang down.

FX-ASPEC-005.says: Side A & B: each bar both ways.

FX-ASPEC-006.says: Analog Lines: one line through the bars' tips.

FX-ASPEC-007.says: Analog Dots: a dot at each tip.

FX-ASPEC-009.says: Orange inside, violet outside, Hue Interpolation 180, thickness 3: each band's colours turned further round the hue.

FX-ASPEC-010.says: FX-ASPEC-009 with Color Symmetry on: the first and last bands match.

FX-ASPEC-011.says: FX-ASPEC-009 with Dynamic Hue Phase on: the turn starts at the loudest band, 300 Hz, the first, so the frame is FX-ASPEC-009's.

FX-ASPEC-012.says: Eight bands at 300, 450 .. 1350 Hz, thickness 3, Side A & B, Blend Overlapping Colors on, orange inside: neighbouring bars overlap and their colours are blended.

FX-ASPEC-013.says: FX-ASPEC-012 with Blend Overlapping Colors off: each bar laid over the last.

FX-ASPEC-014.says: Duration Averaging on: three windows half a window apart, averaged.

FX-ASPEC-015.says: Audio Offset 50 ms: the window starts 240 samples later.

FX-ASPEC-016.says: Audio Duration 20 ms: a window of 96 samples, too short to keep 300 Hz from 600 Hz, so the levels spread.

FX-ASPEC-017.says: Use Polar Path on about the middle, eight bands at 300, 450 .. 1350 Hz, 4 tall at most: the bars stand out round the centre from straight up, clockwise.

FX-ASPEC-018.says: FX-ASPEC-017 as Analog Lines: a closed line round the centre.

FX-ASPEC-019.says: Path 1, a mask (mode None) round the box from (2, 2) to (14, 8), eight bands, 3 tall at most, Side A: the bars stand outward round the box.

FX-ASPEC-020.says: Path 2 with only one mask: none to draw along, so nothing is drawn and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said; the cel as it was.

FX-ASPEC-021.says: Audio Layer "ghost", not in the composition: EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING is said and the cel is as it was.

FX-ASPEC-022.says: Audio Layer "art", the cel itself, which holds no sound: EFFECT_SOUND_MISSING is said and the cel is as it was.

FX-ASPEC-023.says: The stereo file, bands at 600 and 900 Hz among the four: its two channels averaged, 0.3 at 600 Hz and 0.15 at 900 Hz.

FX-ASPEC-024.says: The 24-bit file: as FX-ASPEC-002 within the tolerance.

FX-ASPEC-027.says: The sound layer starting at frame 2: frames 0 and 1 silent, frame 4 its own frame 2.

FX-ASPEC-028.says: The sound layer at -6.0206 dB, half as loud: the bars half as tall.

FX-ASPEC-029.says: Maximum Height keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear.

FX-ASPEC-030.says: FX-ASPEC-002 moved three pixels right: the bars move with the layer.

FX-ASPEC-031.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the points are the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-ASPEC-002's.

FX-ASPEC-032.says: One band, 150 to 450 Hz: one bar at 300 Hz in the middle of the line.

FX-ASPEC-033.says: Start Frequency 1350, End Frequency 150: the bands in the other order, 1200 Hz first.

FX-ASPEC-034.says: Thickness 0: nothing drawn, the cel as it was.

FX-ASPEC-035.says: Frequency Bands 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-036.says: Frequency Bands 4097, above 4096. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-037.says: Start Frequency 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-038.says: End Frequency 20001, above 20000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-039.says: Maximum Height -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-040.says: Audio Duration 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-041.says: Audio Offset 30001, above 30000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-042.says: Thickness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-043.says: Softness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-044.says: Hue Interpolation 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-045.says: Path -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-046.says: Start Point 1001 per cent across, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-047.says: Display Options "bars", not digital, analog_lines or analog_dots. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-048.says: Side Options "side_c". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-049.says: Composite "yes", not on or off. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-050.says: Inside colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-051.says: Use Polar Path "maybe". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-052.says: Audio Layer 5, a number, not a layer's name. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ASPEC-053.says: Frequency Bands keyed to 4097 at frame 4, above 4096. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
